wave_A.label: Reuse Existing Infrastructure
wave_A.description: Can run with existing programmatic PDF fixtures and existing validators. Primary gap is adding to allowed_types and per_type_constraints only (config-only change) or adding one new validator for format output.

wave_B.label: Minor New Work Required
wave_B.description: Needs minor new code: image validators already partially exist (_validate_image_output), need new fixture type or minor config extension. TableGenerator needs TableBuilder BUILDER pattern documented. FormFlattener needs programmatic form fixture.

wave_C.label: Significant New Fixture Code Required
wave_C.description: Requires new fixture code to create PDFs with interactive form fields (AcroForm) programmatically via Aspose.Pdf. Security needs programmatic encrypted PDF creation and password management. FormImporter needs JSON data source fixture alongside form PDF.

wave_D.label: Complex or Externally Blocked
wave_D.description: Signature needs PKCS12 certificate file (can be self-signed programmatically but adds significant complexity). Timestamp requires TSA server URL or offline timestamping. Ofd requires OFD-format input which is a niche Chinese document standard not generatable from existing infrastructure.

DocConverter.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires format-specific output validation for DOC format
DocConverter.output_validator_note: DOC output: check for OLE2 compound document header (D0 CF 11 E0) or DOCX ZIP+word/document.xml. DOCX variant already has xlsx_check pattern; a doc_format_check is new but trivial to implement.
DocConverter.notes: ConversionMode enum (EnhancedFlow, Pure) and SaveFormat enum (Doc, DocX) provide output format control. Use SaveFormat.DocX for OOXML output — reuse xlsx-style ZIP validator.

FormEditor.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires PDF with pre-existing form fields fixture
FormEditor.output_validator_note: Output is still a PDF — existing pdf_magic_byte validator applies. The challenge is the input fixture: need a PDF with AcroForm fields programmatically created via Aspose.Pdf.Forms.
FormEditor.notes: Fixture must create a PDF with at least one interactive AcroForm field. Pattern: Aspose.Pdf.Document + Aspose.Pdf.Forms.TextBoxField. Multiple OPTIONS sub-types (FormEditorAddOptions, FormEditorSetOptions, FormEditorRemoveOptions) mean multiple scenario variants possible.

FormExporter.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires form-fields PDF fixture + output format specification
FormExporter.output_validator_note: FormExporterToJsonOptions produces JSON output — json_check validator already exists. FormExporterValuesToCsvOptions produces CSV — text validator already exists. Output validator is not the blocker; fixture is.
FormExporter.notes: Shares AcroForm fixture requirement with FormEditor. If FormEditor fixture is built first, FormExporter can reuse it. Best validated with FormExporterToJsonOptions variant (json_check) as JSON output is easiest to validate.

FormFlattener.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires PDF with interactive form fields
FormFlattener.output_validator_note: Output is a PDF with flattened fields — pdf_magic_byte check is sufficient. Semantic validation could additionally confirm no interactive fields remain but that requires Aspose.Pdf introspection in the validator.
FormFlattener.notes: FormFlattenAllFieldsOptions is the simplest variant — no field name selection required. If AcroForm fixture is created for FormEditor wave, FormFlattener can reuse it directly. Output PDF check with pdf_magic_byte is sufficient for basic validation.

FormImporter.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires pair input (PDF + data source) fixture strategy
FormImporter.output_validator_note: Output is a PDF with imported field data — pdf_magic_byte check sufficient. The fixture complexity is the dual-input: AcroForm PDF + FormJsonImportSource (JSON file with field values).
FormImporter.notes: FormJsonImportSource is a dedicated DATA_SOURCE type for JSON form data import. The JSON file must contain field-name/value pairs matching the AcroForm field names in the input PDF. Requires two programmatic artifacts: (1) PDF with named form fields, (2) JSON with matching field values.

Html.pilot_deferred_reason: HTML input fixture strategy differs from PDF input strategy
Html.output_validator_note: HTML-to-PDF conversion output is a PDF — pdf_magic_byte validator already exists and applies directly.
Html.notes: fixture_factory.py already has generate_html() function — HTML fixture generation is already implemented. The template_hints in pdf.yml only cover PDF inputs; adding HTML input strategy is a minor config extension. Bidirectional: PdfToHtmlOptions covers PDF-to-HTML direction (output = html_check validator). Two variants possible from this single WORKFLOW_ROOT type.

ImageExtractor.pilot_deferred_reason: Output validation for extracted images not yet defined
ImageExtractor.output_validator_note: _validate_image_output already exists in output_validator.py and handles PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF headers. The gap is the input fixture: need a PDF that contains an embedded image. Programmatic creation via Aspose.Pdf.Image + Document.
ImageExtractor.notes: Process() inherited from IPlugin (method_count=0 in catalog, same pattern as TextExtractor). Result is image files in ResultCollection. Fixture needs a PDF with at least one embedded image — programmable via Aspose.Pdf.Document + XImage. Output validator already handles image format bytes.

Jpeg.pilot_deferred_reason: JPEG output format-specific validation not yet implemented
Jpeg.output_validator_note: _validate_image_output already checks JPEG header (0xFF 0xD8). This validator already exists and covers JPEG. The only gap is adding Jpeg to allowed_types and configuring per_type_constraints.
Jpeg.notes: PDF-to-JPEG conversion. Input is any PDF (programmatic_pdf_single reusable). Output validator already exists (_validate_image_output with JPEG check). Config change only: add to allowed_types, add per_type_constraints with JpegOptions usage. Method inherited from IPlugin (method_count=0).

Ofd.output_validator_note: Output is a PDF — validator already exists. The blocker is the input: OFD (Open Fixed-layout Document) is a Chinese national standard. No stdlib/programmatic generator exists in the current stack.
Ofd.external_blocker: OFD format (GB/T 33190-2016 Chinese national standard) requires either a pre-existing OFD binary file or a dedicated OFD authoring library. No Python/C# programmatic generator available in current stack. Requires sourcing an OFD sample file from an external repository.
Ofd.notes: OFD is used primarily in Chinese government/financial document systems. Obtaining a valid OFD test fixture requires either: (1) downloading a sample OFD from a public repository, (2) using a third-party OFD generation library. Not generatable from Aspose.Pdf.Document API.

PdfAConverter.pilot_deferred_reason: PDF/A compliance validation not yet implemented
PdfAConverter.output_validator_note: Output is a PDF — pdf_magic_byte check applies for basic validation. Full PDF/A compliance check requires reading XMP metadata for conformance marker. A lightweight check: verify %PDF- header + check for XMP metadata block containing 'pdfa:conformance'. This is a new validator but implementable without external tools.
PdfAConverter.notes: PdfAStandardVersion enum (PDF_A_1A, PDF_A_1B, PDF_A_2A, etc.) controls target standard. For initial healing, PDF_A_1B is the most broadly supported. Minimum validator: check %PDF- header (pdf_magic_byte) — conformance marker is a best-effort bonus check. PdfAValidationResult is the result type for validate mode.

PdfExtractor.pilot_deferred_reason: Output validation for extracted content not yet defined
PdfExtractor.output_validator_note: PdfExtractor likely returns text/content results similar to TextExtractor. ResultCollection pattern already established. If output is StringResult, the existing TextExtractor pattern applies (cast to StringResult, check .Text). If output is FileResult, pdf_magic_byte check applies.
PdfExtractor.notes: PdfExtractor has method_count=2 (unlike TextExtractor which has 0) confirming explicit Process() methods in catalog. The output type from ResultCollection needs verification — could be StringResult (text content) or FileResult (extracted files). Programmatic PDF with known text (programmatic_pdf_known_text) is the appropriate fixture.

PdfToImage.pilot_deferred_reason: Image output validation strategy not yet defined
PdfToImage.output_validator_note: _validate_image_output already handles PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF headers. PdfToImageOptions presumably supports configuring output format. Use PNG output format to leverage existing PNG validator check (0x89 PNG header).
PdfToImage.notes: Output is image files (one per page). ResultCollection will contain FileResult entries. Image format validator already exists. Per_type_constraints should specify output format (e.g., PNG) to ensure deterministic validator path. Method_count=2 confirms explicit Process() in catalog.

Png.pilot_deferred_reason: PNG output format-specific validation not yet implemented
Png.output_validator_note: _validate_image_output already checks PNG header (0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47). This validator already exists. Config change + per_type_constraints sufficient.
Png.notes: PDF-to-PNG conversion. Identical pattern to Jpeg. Input: programmatic_pdf_single. Output validator: image_format (PNG branch already implemented). Method inherited from IPlugin (method_count=0). Simplest image conversion type to heal.

Security.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires encrypted PDF fixture and password management
Security.output_validator_note: Encrypted PDF output still has %PDF- header — pdf_magic_byte check applies. Decryption output is a plain PDF. Encryption scenario output should fail to open without password (but validating encryption requires reading PDF encryption dict — adds complexity).
Security.notes: Two sub-scenarios: (1) Encryption — input is plain PDF, output is encrypted PDF. Fixture: programmatic_pdf_single. (2) Decryption — input must be a pre-encrypted PDF (requires encryption step first, or programmatic creation of encrypted PDF via Aspose.Pdf.Document.Encrypt()). Decryption scenario is more testable: encrypt then decrypt in same example, validate %PDF- on output.

SelectField.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires PDF with select form fields fixture
SelectField.output_validator_note: SelectField operations modify form field selection state. Output is still a PDF — pdf_magic_byte check applies for basic validation.
SelectField.notes: SelectField has method_count=3 (highest of all deferred form types). Requires PDF with checkboxes/radio buttons/combo boxes. Shares AcroForm fixture requirement with FormEditor. Should be batched after FormEditor fixture infrastructure is established.

Signature.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires PKCS12 certificate fixture; complex security setup
Signature.output_validator_note: Signed PDF still has %PDF- header. Signature presence could be verified by checking for /Sig annotation in PDF structure but that requires PDF parsing beyond magic-byte check.
Signature.external_blocker: Requires a PKCS12 (.pfx/.p12) certificate file. Self-signed certificate can be generated programmatically using .NET X509Certificate2 + CertificateRequest APIs (available in .NET 5+). However, this adds significant C# fixture complexity and the certificate must be included as a test fixture artifact.
Signature.notes: Self-signed cert generation is possible in .NET without external CA. Pattern: new CertificateRequest(...).CreateSelfSigned(...).Export(X509ContentType.Pfx, password). However this requires System.Security.Cryptography namespaces and adds non-LowCode dependencies. Alternative: ship a pre-generated test.pfx file as a fixture artifact.

TableGenerator.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires complex TableBuilder pattern for constructing table structure
TableGenerator.output_validator_note: Output is a newly generated PDF — pdf_magic_byte check applies directly.
TableGenerator.notes: TableGenerator is unique — it generates a PDF from scratch (no input PDF needed). The 'fixture' is the TableBuilder configuration: TableOptions.AddTable(new TableBuilder().AddRow(new TableRowBuilder().AddCell(new TableCellBuilder().AddParagraph('text')))). All builder types (TableBuilder, TableRowBuilder, TableCellBuilder, TableOptions) are BUILDER-role types already in the catalog. No external input file required. LLM needs clear per_type_constraints documenting the builder pattern.

Tiff.pilot_deferred_reason: TIFF format output validation; image conversion deferred to later pilot
Tiff.output_validator_note: _validate_image_output already checks TIFF header (b'II' or b'MM' byte order markers). This validator already exists and covers TIFF. Identical pattern to Jpeg/Png.
Tiff.notes: PDF-to-TIFF conversion. Input: programmatic_pdf_single. Output validator: image_format (TIFF branch already implemented in _validate_image_output). Method inherited from IPlugin (method_count=0). Config change only after per_type_constraints documented.

Timestamp.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires timestamp server configuration or local cert fixture
Timestamp.output_validator_note: Timestamped PDF still has %PDF- header — pdf_magic_byte check applies for basic output validation.
Timestamp.external_blocker: RFC 3161 timestamp token requires a live TSA (Timestamp Authority) server URL or a local TSA stub. Free public TSAs (e.g., freetsa.org) require internet connectivity during test runs which is not guaranteed in CI. A local TSA stub requires implementing RFC 3161 response generation — significant infrastructure work.
Timestamp.notes: Possible mitigation: check if TimestampOptions supports a local file-based timestamp (not RFC 3161 network-based). If Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.Timestamp supports PKCS7 detached timestamp without network TSA, this could be unblocked with a local certificate fixture similar to Signature. Requires further API research.

TocGenerator.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires PDF with headings/sections for meaningful TOC generation
TocGenerator.output_validator_note: TOC generation output is still a PDF — pdf_magic_byte validator applies. Semantic validation of actual TOC presence would require PDF text extraction but is optional for initial healing.
TocGenerator.notes: Fixture extension: add heading-style paragraphs to the programmatic PDF creation. Pattern: doc.Pages.Add() + page.Paragraphs.Add(new TextFragment('Chapter 1') { TextState = { FontSize = 18 } }). Multi-page PDF with heading paragraphs gives TOC something to work with. Output check: pdf_magic_byte only needed.

XlsConverter.pilot_deferred_reason: Requires format-specific output validation for XLS format
XlsConverter.output_validator_note: _validate_xlsx_output already exists in output_validator.py and validates ZIP structure + xl/workbook.xml presence. For XLSX output variant, this validator applies directly. For XLS (binary .xls), would need OLE2 compound document header check — but XLSX output is preferable.
XlsConverter.notes: Use XLSX output format (not legacy XLS binary) to leverage existing xlsx_check validator. Per_type_constraints should specify XLSX output. Input: programmatic_pdf_single with some tabular text content (programmatic_pdf_known_text variant sufficient). The xlsx_check validator already implemented.
